title: Global Regulatory & Statutory Open Metadata Index (2024–2026) — 41,330 Official Dossiers Across 38 Jurisdictions
description:
Automated, machine-readable bibliographic metadata catalog (CSV, JSONL, Frictionless Data Package, and complete per-jurisdiction Markdown directories) indexing 41,330 official primary and secondary laws, final and proposed rules, statutory instruments, central bank circulars, supreme audit reports, and multilateral resolutions across 929 government departments, ministries, regulatory agencies, and multilateral organs in 38 active jurisdictions: United States (15,449 dossiers | Catalog), United Kingdom (3,016 dossiers | Catalog), Canada (5,384 dossiers | Catalog), European Union (5,181 dossiers | Catalog), United Nations (6,985 dossiers | Catalog), Ireland (186 dossiers | Catalog), Australia (1,319 dossiers | Catalog), International (1,126 dossiers | Catalog), Switzerland (190 dossiers | Catalog), Finland (67 dossiers | Catalog), France (486 dossiers | Catalog), South Korea (66 dossiers | Catalog), Norway (71 dossiers | Catalog), Italy (76 dossiers | Catalog), Philippines (414 dossiers | Catalog), Poland (43 dossiers | Catalog), South Africa (46 dossiers | Catalog), India (15 dossiers | Catalog), Belgium (91 dossiers | Catalog), Brazil (85 dossiers | Catalog), Japan (93 dossiers | Catalog), Netherlands (35 dossiers | Catalog), Russia (34 dossiers | Catalog), Sweden (49 dossiers | Catalog), Austria (178 dossiers | Catalog), China (31 dossiers | Catalog), Czechia (36 dossiers | Catalog), Germany (150 dossiers | Catalog), Denmark (43 dossiers | Catalog), Estonia (16 dossiers | Catalog), Spain (41 dossiers | Catalog), Israel (139 dossiers | Catalog), Lithuania (0 dossiers | Catalog), Portugal (42 dossiers | Catalog), Saudi Arabia (47 dossiers | Catalog), Singapore (82 dossiers | Catalog), Ukraine (1 dossiers | Catalog), Iceland (17 dossiers | Catalog).

Full plain-English executive briefings, structured HTML compliance matrices, semantic definition lists, two-stage Tables of Contents, authority RSS syndication feeds, and unabridged source PDF dossiers are accessible via each record's canonical URL on https://www.indexdata.org, the Complete Issuing Authority Directory, the AI/LLM manifests (llms.txt and llms-full.txt), and Wikidata entity Q142071440.
